mapper.select: SELECT rep.report_id ,rep.report_type ,rep.reason ,rep.`status` ,CONCAT_WS(' ', reg.province, reg.city, reg.district, pro.detail_address) AS address ,CASE WHEN usr.`role` = 'AGENT' THEN age.office_name ELSE usr.`name` END AS reporter ,DATE_FORMAT(rep.created_at,'%Y.%m.%d') AS report_date ,cnt.count_by_property ,pro.property_id ,pro.property_type ,pro.area_m2 ,pro.`floor` ,img.image_url AS thumbnail_url FROM report rep LEFT OUTER JOIN property pro ON rep.property_id = pro.property_id LEFT OUTER JOIN region reg ON pro.region_id = reg.region_id LEFT OUTER JOIN user usr ON usr.user_id = rep.user_id LEFT OUTER JOIN agent age ON usr.user_id = age.user_id LEFT OUTER JOIN (SELECT property_id, MAX(image_url) AS image_url FROM property_image WHERE deleted_at IS NULL AND is_thumbnail = 1 GROUP BY property_id ) img ON pro.property_id = img.property_id LEFT OUTER JOIN (SELECT property_id ,COUNT(*) AS count_by_property /* 기간내 누적 신고 건수 */ FROM report WHERE deleted_at IS NULL GROUP BY property_id ) cnt ON rep.property_id = cnt.property_id WHERE rep.deleted_at IS NULL ORDER BY cnt.count_by_property DESC, rep.created_at DESC, rep.report_id DESC LIMIT #{size} OFFSET #{offset}
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM report WHERE deleted_at IS NULL
mapper.update: UPDATE property SET deleted_at = NOW() WHERE property_id = #{propertyId}
